name: Screen with European Figures (obverse)
material: painted enamel, glass painting, and cast-iron stand
dimensions: without base: 65.8 x 32.4 cm (25 7/8 x 12 3/4 in.)
summary: This two-sided table screen is an enamel-painted copper plaque with European figures. European enamelware was introduced to China through missionary-artists at the Beijing court and foreign trade in Guangzhou.
